page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page, p. 187): running head at top with page number at top right; one column of running text; a printer's ornament in the middle of the page with a bold "CAP." mark beside it; lower text below the ornament, then a faint line at the foot. No marginal notes on this page. The strip at the left edge is the neighbouring page and the faint text in the middle is show-through, so both are left out.

main_text.p: & fidei hæc vox est. Pergit Hofius, Et in fine dicit Sacerdos, SI Dominus voluerit te secundum peccata tua judicare, dicas, Domine Deus, ego pono mortem Domini nostri Jesu Christi inter me & judicium tuum, — & in manus tuas, Domine, commendo spiritum meum. Et post, cum consimilem professionem à quodam Dominicano factam commemorâsset, Hæc est, inquit, fides Catholica, quæ neminem fallere potest. Hactenus de hoc Argumento. Ad proximum festinamus.
main_text.head: Ass CAP.[?]
main_text.p: Maior ex Scriptoris facile evincitur, in quo hæreticum, tanquam nobilissimum [illegible, ~10 letters] dum perveniendi ad vitam æternam, [illegible, ~12 letters] ut enim [illegible, ~8 letters] vestros [illegible, ~8 letters] nullos [illegible, ~4 letters] ulla dis-tro.

page.notes: The bold "Ass CAP." mark above the lower text is uncertain. The lower text is faint and partly blurred, so most of its words are marked as illegible. The faint line at the bottom left ("I. Tu e…") is too faint to read and is not transcribed. The show-through text in the centre of the page and the neighbouring page at the left edge are not transcribed.
